architecture: ResNet34 Attention U-Net++ (scSE) + CoANet road specialist
overall_accuracy_scope: Refined Pune development pixels; not independent unseen-city test accuracy
checkpoint_format: torch-safe original-component bundle; not a plain state_dict
supported_inputs: projected metre-based GeoTIFF at the declared resolution
limitations: Research prototype; no arbitrary-location accuracy guarantee
Road surfaces are not a validated navigation graph
licence_note: Academic/non-commercial research only for the included CoANet dependency; retain upstream notices; not commercially cleared

road_specialist.local_scope: Three reused development crops, not blind test data
road_specialist.external_scope: 48 frozen LoveDA public validation tiles; not the full benchmark
road_specialist.output_policy: Separate road-surface layer; does not silently overwrite five-class labels

weights_mirror_note: The existing verified combined-release download remains a checksum-pinned fallback; this repository also stores the actual weights via Git LFS.
